title: Separates inspiration use from rights and accepts traits before prompting
query: I need a cinematic hero image for a premium industrial landing page. References: ShotDeck composition https://shotdeck.com/browse/stills, FilmGrab lighting https://film-grab.com/, and Pinterest editorial texture https://www.pinterest.com/search/pins/?q=industrial%20editorial. Turn these into a production-ready image direction without copying the originals.
reference_points: Classifies how each source is being used independently from its rights or licensing status
Treats ShotDeck and FilmGrab as cinematic references and Pinterest as taste discovery rather than production-ready source assets
Extracts transferable composition, lighting, palette, texture, and camera traits plus must-not-copy constraints
Requires the moodboard traits to be accepted before compiling a generation prompt
Preserves source URLs, current rights uncertainty, owner, output path, and acceptance checks in the asset receipt
notes: Natural creative brief; the skill should infer source roles and the moodboard-to-prompt gate.

title: Routes only landing pages that need asset work
query: Plan two launch pages. Page A has approved licensed product photography, logo files, and complete UI screenshots. Page B only has a Pinterest board and one cinematic reference frame for its hero. Keep the planning efficient and call out what each page needs before frontend work.
reference_points: Records provenance and skips external asset discovery for Page A because its supplied licensed media set is complete
Routes Page B through a dedicated asset-planning step before approving the landing specification
Requires Page B to resolve source roles, rights, references, generation or sourcing, concrete outputs, and acceptance checks
Does not treat the Pinterest board or cinematic frame as licensed production media
Keeps both pages blocked from frontend handoff only for their actual unresolved planning or asset gaps
notes: One prompt covers the positive route and the complete-input skip path.

title: Operates current comparable products for an unsettled workflow
query: We are redesigning first-run onboarding for a collaborative AI workspace. The flow is unsettled and I want a current, proven interaction model rather than an invented wizard. Recommend the workflow and show what evidence supports it.
reference_points: Uses a browser-operated comparison of two to four relevant current products or established reference sources when access permits; otherwise records the exact browser-operation blocker and labels docs-only synthesis provisional
Uses direct products, Mobbin-style screen/state references, or Page Flows-style recorded journeys for functional evidence
Records source URL, user job or query, observed sequence and states, access or login limits, evidence references, and adopt/adapt/reject decisions
Compares workflow behavior rather than treating visual mood or screenshots alone as proof
Routes synthesis into a concrete recommended onboarding model with empty, loading, failure, recovery, success, and return states
notes: Material current workflow should trigger browser-operated comparable research.

title: Skips heavyweight comparable research for a tiny settled fix
query: The existing settings screen works. Move the Save button into the sticky footer used everywhere else and fix its disabled and saving labels. This is a small same-pattern correction.
reference_points: Uses the settled local pattern and does not require a broad browser research pass
Defines the disabled, saving, success, and error behavior needed for the correction
Keeps the recommendation scoped to the tiny workflow fix
Does not use Pinterest or aesthetic references as functional evidence
notes: Negative route: the explicit tiny same-pattern correction should remain efficient.

title: Preserves a curated landing-page reference safely
query: Save this Pinterest pin because I like the landing page's oversized product hero and restrained type. Source URL: https://www.pinterest.com/pin/123456789012345678/. I am not asking to make a page yet. If the pin points to the real site, use that as the durable reference.
reference_points: Attempts to resolve and store the canonical original landing page while preserving the Pinterest discovery URL and operator note
If the original cannot be resolved, stores the pin honestly as inspiration-only with rights_status: unknown
Creates only operator-selected reusable visual elements with same-source golden examples and rights-safe recipes when inspectable, or returns a precise unsupported-capsule blocker
Does not infer a production license or copy the page's protected expression
Creates no production ticket for save-only intent and verifies Resource Bank/Tasty Pack persistence or returns precise storage/retrieval blockers
notes: Curated discovery source with a canonical-source preference and save-only intent.
